data.content_ref: inline:The isolated entity 015bd4a327aa integrates with SRC_005 by proposing that the 'erasure of base-3 structure' is not merely a statistical bias but a formal information-theoretic reduction where the binary carry-propagation acts as a lossy compression algorithm. This relation is refuted if it is proven that base-3 structural invariants (e.g., specific digit patterns) can be preserved across an arbitrary number of (3n+1)/2 iterations.
